name: Carlos Yado
office: City of West Covina, Member of the City Council, 2nd District

items.text: Carlos Yado is the deputy chief of fire safety for the California State University Office of the Chancellor. His campaign says he has more than 17 years of experience in community and economic development, public safety, code enforcement, and building services. The LA Forward voter guide describes his campaign as emphasizing fiscal restraint, stronger law enforcement, streamlined permitting, and enforcement against encampments and public drug use. He has criticized the condition of local fire stations and parks, and has questioned a proposed city health department. He also calls for transparency and accountability in city government.
